data.action: 立于钢铁残骸之上，神情清冷孤傲
data.description: 【绫波丽 · 漆黑作战服与赤红大地】近第三次冲击后的荒凉大地上，赤红色的结晶地貌向地平线无尽延伸。黑丽身着紧身哑光黑战斗服，站在锈蚀的钢铁骨架之上，红色眼眸茫然地环视着这片死寂的世界——「命令是什么？我必须驾驶九号机吗？除了命令之外……真正的我，又该去往何方？」
data.lighting: 血色残阳与昏暗废土反光
data.location: 近第三次冲击后废墟荒野
data.promptProse: Rei stands on a rusted steel framework in her matte-black Mark.09 plugsuit with neon-orange accents, looking uncertainly over the red crystalline wasteland. The dramatic low wide view keeps the framework crossing the foreground and crystal ridges extending to the horizon. Blood-colored sunset glances along the metal and dark suit panels; muted ground reflections add red light beneath her hands and interface clips against the dim sky.
data.title: 绫波丽 · 漆黑作战服与赤红大地
